cases.question: ¿Cuántas sesiones cerradas tuvo cada caja durante septiembre de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT cr.name AS caja, COUNT(*) AS sesiones FROM cash_session cs JOIN cash_register cr ON cr.id = cs.cash_register_id WHERE cs.status = 'CLOSED' AND cs.closed_at >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND cs.closed_at < DATE '2026-10-01' GROUP BY cr.id, cr.name ORDER BY sesiones DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT cr.name AS caja, COUNT(cs.id) AS total_sesiones FROM public.cash_session AS cs JOIN public.cash_register AS cr ON cs.cash_register_id = cr.id WHERE cs.status = 'CLOSED' AND cs.closed_at >= CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND cs.closed_at < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY cr.name LIMIT 50
